newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end slightly up ahead of data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end slightly up ahead of data.

text.p: U.S. debt futures closed higher, but off peaks after a steady light grind to the upside faded ahead of a heavy line-up of U.S. economic reports this week, traders and analysts said.
The reports, which start on Tuesday morning with U.S. April retail sales data, may clarify the U.S. rate outlook ahead of the Federal Open Market Committee's (FOMC) meeting on May 20.
Any signs the U.S. real economic growth rate is slowing down will continue to push June T-bonds and December Eurodollars to the upside, they said.
On Monday, the consolidation in June T-bonds and Eurodollars continued to have an upward bias.
June T-bonds rose through 110-14/32, Friday's high and a level which has kept a lid on the market for the last two-and-a-half months. June inched up to 110-16/32 in light volume.
Major resistance now rests at 111-04/32, a trendline level from December 1996 on the daily bar charts, Barrett Lewald, senior financial futures strategist at Lind-Waldock, Inc, said.
"Between those two levels, we'll need fundamental information to push us higher," Lewald said.

At 0830 EDT/1230 GMT on Tuesday, April retail sales will be released. Sales are forecast to fall 0.3 percent, versus up 0.1 percent in March, and sales excluding autos are seen rising 0.1 percent, compared to up 0.5 percent in March.
Two weekly chain store sales reports will also be released, as well as the April Atlanta Federal Reserve index and the Richmond Fed's survey.
The April U.S. producer price index will be released on Wednesday, followed by the April consumer price index on Thursday.
While futures business was light and quiet, trade for bond options on futures was jolted when one major U.S. dealer bought 12,000 September calls at 112-00.

At the end of pit trade, June T-bonds were up 05/32 at 110-12/32, 10-year notes were up 04/32 at 107-17/32, muni bonds were 05/32 higher at 115-30/32, September T-bills were up 0.015 at 94.535, and December Eurodollars were up 0.015 at 93.735. ((Derivatives desk 312-408-8750))
